description: This file defines classes and functions related to distributed communication in PyTorch, including GradBucket, CommHookInterface, and CppCommHookInterface, used for gradient synchronization and communication hooks in distributed data parallel training.

classes.name: GradBucket
classes.description: Represents a bucket of gradients used in distributed data parallel training, providing access to buffer, parameters, and gradient information.

classes.name: CommHookInterface
classes.description: Abstract base class for communication hooks that handle gradient synchronization asynchronously.

classes.name: CppCommHookInterface
classes.description: Template class implementing CommHookInterface, allowing custom state and parsing hook results.

methods.name: broadcast_coalesced
methods.description: Broadcasts multiple tensors to all processes in the process group.

methods.name: GradBucket::getIndex
methods.description: Returns the unique index of the gradient bucket.

methods.name: GradBucket::getBuffer
methods.description: Returns a const reference to the buffer tensor.

methods.name: GradBucket::getBufferRef
methods.description: Returns a mutable reference to the buffer tensor.

methods.name: GradBucket::getGradients
methods.description: Returns the list of gradient tensors associated with the bucket.

methods.name: GradBucket::getParameters
methods.description: Returns the model parameters belonging to this bucket.

methods.name: GradBucket::isLast
methods.description: Checks if this is the last bucket to allreduce in an iteration.

methods.name: CommHookInterface::runHook
methods.description: Executes the communication hook asynchronously with a gradient bucket.

methods.name: CommHookInterface::parseHookResult
methods.description: Parses the result of the communication hook into a tensor.

methods.name: detail::parseCppCommHookResult
methods.description: Helper function to parse C++ communication hook result from IValue.

methods.name: CppCommHookInterface::parseHookResult
methods.description: Parses hook result using the provided static function.
